structured.answer: From what I understood, at my age (past retirement age) I could take the money out without tax after 3 years, and other people have to wait 6 years from the first deposit. As for how much, I could only find the site's own example, someone putting in 300 ₪ a month with 900 ₪ from the employer, which comes to something like 50,000–66,000 ₪ after about 5 years. That isn't my salary, and in that example part of the money went to tax, so I'll ask you or the bank before I decide anything.

findings.what: The example opens with stocks and English letters ('מסלול מדד', 'S&P500'). To me that says gambling, not saving, and almost made me close the page.
There are too many different totals (54,000 / 50,719 / 29,768 / 15,794 / 66,601 / 66,280) and none of them clearly says 'this is what you get'.
A red/pink minus number and striped bars sit in the middle of the example. It frightens me and I backed off.
The page is dark with grey text, which is hard to read even with glasses. The small grey lines such as 'גררו את הסמן...' and 'מה קורה כשהמעסיק מפסיק להפקיד' are pale.
The bar colours are too close (yellow vs dark-yellow vs grey) for me to tell apart.
The sticky header hides the start of a paragraph, so I came in mid-sentence.
The rule for my age ('לגיל הפרישה מספיקות 3 שנים') is buried mid-paragraph. It should be up front.
There are many 'חוקים וכללים · number' buttons and codes like KH-19. It looks busy and official-ish, but it means nothing to me.
I don't know who 'מקור' is. It's not a bank I know.
